title: Pageflip timed out! This is a bug in the amdgpu kernel driver
body: Hi guys, gals... I am longtime archlinux user, but never registered in the forum. Previously I used Archlinux for many years ago for a long time, then switched to Kubuntu for some years, and now I am back to ArchLinux. I have a serious issue with this bug, I can barely use my PC everything freezes with the message "Pageflip timed out! This is a bug in the amdgpu kernel driver".... Things I tried, adding amdgpu.dcdebugmask=0x12 and its variants to grub, didnt solve it. I also tried switching the 6700XT for a rx 580, and guess what? the bug was also present! ffs Also tried using an older kernel, some people report that with 6.6 or older kernels this doesnt happen, well it still happens for me, This is driving nuts, I am considering buying new hardware! but what should I buy? it isnt the GPU, maybe a new mobo? I dont know what to do, I am desperate. PLEASE HELP! My setup: Ryzen 5700X, 24 gb ddr4, Gigabyte Aorus Pro b450, Asrock Challenger 6700XT Last edited by MrKoopa (2026-09-20 00:54:56)
